scope: Four synthetic integer business rules; valid inputs only; not the 12-task full protocol; no AI comparison.

tasks.rule: If amount is at least 10000 cents, discount is floor(amount/10) cents; otherwise discount is zero. Return the discount cents only.
Return tax cents equal to amount*rate/10000 rounded to nearest integer, exact halves rounded upward. Inputs nonnegative; no tax cap, exemption or threshold.
Return refundable cents as the smaller of requested and paid minus refunded. Zero is permitted. No fees or minimum refund.
Return boolean true if and only if age is at least 18, tenure is at least 6, and suspended is false.
